args.title: Tamarack Components: Freight Pricing Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of Tamarack Components newsletter, linked article, and companion piece:

• Newsletter: This quarter's focus is freight pricing, with the full article on the Tamarack blog and a matching case study available for readers on active projects.
• Article (blog.tamarack.example/2026/freight): Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Companion piece: Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
